postV1Policy: No active implementation phase. Optional provider integrations require a separately authorized post-v1 project.

invariants: Human authority remains above Actor and Agent
Mold is a permissioned operating contract
Work Order is a proposal and never self-authorizes
Task Lease owns one task scope
Opening or configuring a specialist never executes
Make Production is the sole Production execution transition
Human acceptance is final and role-specific
Source and accepted Assets remain immutable
Specialist-native and Gummy OS Receipts remain distinct and linked
Production-specific choices do not silently become Actor memory
Local Gummy Box works without an external account
Night Gummy and Day Gummy are the only canonical expressions
The five locked brand hue anchors do not change
Simulated and genuine results are never conflated

phases.name: freeze-release-baseline
phases.exit: exact repository reality is recorded and no competing release lane is ambiguous

phases.name: product-readiness-audit-and-surgical-cleanup
outputs: truthful current application and specialist states
phases.exit: no known product-understanding or protected-pillar blocker remains

phases.name: first-run-copy-and-setup
outputs: complete state copy and progressive disclosure
phases.exit: clean first-run browser acceptance passes and persists

phases.name: canonical-golden-production-path
outputs: deterministic results, Human acceptance, handoffs, and linked Receipts
phases.exit: complete local deterministic Production journey passes after restart

phases.name: real-imagehoss-integration
outputs: original/proxy Assets, compare, accept, hoss, VideoBoss handoff, linked Receipts
phases.liveEvidencePolicy: PASS when supported ComfyUI smoke proves genuine output; otherwise NOT CLAIMED with complete unavailable state
phases.exit: all preflight acceptance requirements are automated

phases.name: real-videoboss-integration
outputs: versioned sequence, shot packet, take, and acceptance records
review, Human acceptance, delivery, and linked Receipts
phases.liveEvidencePolicy: PASS when a real provider smoke succeeds; otherwise NOT CLAIMED with complete broker contract and unavailable state

phases.name: real-meshmallow-integration
outputs: public Meshmallow name with legacy 3D Bee compatibility
versioned world intent, scene package, plan, checkpoint, and engine handoff
bounded operations, validation, acceptance, and linked Receipts
phases.liveEvidencePolicy: PASS when supported Blender produces genuine validated artifacts; otherwise NOT CLAIMED with complete mock and fail-closed discovery
phases.exit: Gummy OS can configure and truthfully operate or gate Meshmallow

phases.name: gummy-box-backup-recovery-and-optional-connections
outputs: inspect-first versioned backup export and import
phases.exit: local start, close/reopen, backup, restore, and disconnect journeys pass

phases.name: release-hardening-and-polish
phases.exit: full acceptance matrix passes or exact optional live routes are NOT CLAIMED

phases.name: release-candidate-prs-deployment-and-return
outputs: one final PR per touched repository
phases.exit: all required gates PASS and Gummy OS final PR is merged, or fully implemented PR remains open with exact blocker
